name: Seminole County, FL
findings: Seminole County has 1,366 nonprofit organizations. 501 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 397 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Seminole County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few community organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 community organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.
